items.title: When Every Hospital Becomes The Same Hospital — Dr Ng Kuo Chern
items.summary: Commoditisation means that care provided is reduced to the lowest reimbursable denominator: the cheapest medications and implants, and the lowest prices. It is here that we need to exercise caution on the conversation around health care affordability. items.title: High Costs Stall Malaysia’s Shift To Closed-House Poultry Farming
items.summary: Malaysia's push for closed-house poultry farming has stalled, with only 8% of poultry houses fully adopting the system after nearly three decades. DVS says high costs remain the biggest barrier, especially for small and medium-sized farmers. The post High Costs Stall Malaysia’s Shift To Closed-House Poultry Farming appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Study: 27% Of UM Medical Graduates Since 2018 Hold Active Singapore Registration
items.summary: About 27% of UM medical grads since 2018, or 314 doctors, hold active Singapore registration. Over 10% registered with the Singapore Medical Council (SMC) after obtaining full registration in Malaysia. SMC-only proportion rose markedly in recent cohorts. items.title: AI Can Cut Blanket Antibiotic Use In Livestock Farms: Expert
items.summary: UPM's Prof Goh Yong Meng says AI can help livestock farmers reduce antibiotic use, thus curbing antimicrobial resistance, by detecting sick animals through movement, sound, and biometric data, allowing targeted treatment instead of medicating entire herds. items.title: Doctors, Nurses Demand Safe Workplaces After Sexual Harassment Complaints
items.summary: MMA and MNU want fair and prompt probes into sexual harassment complaints. The doctors' group and nurses' union demand a safe workplace for health workers, following sexual harassment claims against a KL hospital HOD and a Kota Kinabalu hospital director. items.title: Sexual Harassment Under-Reported In Malaysia’s Medical Profession: Doctors
items.summary: Senior doctors say sexual harassment is under-reported in Malaysia's medical profession and that senior consultants are especially powerful in the public sector. Two doctors have personally witnessed or received requests for help over sexual harassment. items.title: Nearly Half Of Malaysia’s Farmers Are Aged 60 And Above
items.summary: Nearly half of Malaysia’s agricultural producers are aged 60 and above, while almost 78% are aged 46 and above. KPKM says employability at its training institutes rose to 81.2% in 2024 from 78.1% in 2023 and aims to raise it to 85% by 2030. items.title: MOH: 54% Of Housemanship Slots Nationwide Filled After Three Intakes
items.summary: MOH says over half, or 6,580, of 12,198 housemanship training slots nationwide were filled after the first three recruitment rounds in 2026. The ministry says current training capacity remains sufficient for the remaining three intake exercises.
